title: feature-risk-checklist
description: Mirrors harness/scripts/feature_checklist.py — a serialized + frozen feature/risk checklist. Values come from an independent @independent-revalidator re-derivation; this schema only validates SHAPE, not content correctness.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; injectable at emit time for deterministic tests

content_sha256.description: sha256 digest over the record's stable content (excludes content_sha256 itself and run_seq); detects a post-freeze back-edit

run_seq.description: Stamped by artifact_io.stamp_and_write; additive, excluded from the digest
